flagged.location: Definition, paragraph beginning “The static Prasad–Sommerfield sector has”
flagged.evidence: The fields are introduced as a smooth map Φ on ℝ³ and a spatial one-form A=Aᵢdxⁱ, but the paragraph then asserts “∂ₜAᵢ=∂ₜΦ=0, A₀=0.” Neither time-dependent fields nor a temporal component A₀ are defined, so these expressions are undefined on the stated objects.

flagged.location: Definition, boundary-data paragraph beginning “The boundary data fix a number v>0”
flagged.evidence: The paragraph requires that “The limiting tangential covariant derivative of n∞ vanishes, and the limiting magnetic field lies” in its stabilizer, but does not define the finite-radius adapted connection and its limit, the tangential derivative on S², or the magnetic-field limit and its scaling. The separately defined Bᵢ does not specify whether the boundary datum is B(Rω) or the R²-scaled radial component.

flagged.location: Statement, first paragraph: “B_infty takes values in the centralizer of n_infty”
flagged.evidence: The Statement defines the limiting angular curvature 𝓕ₐ,∞ but does not define B∞ or identify it with a coefficient or radial limit of that two-form. Thus the stated centralizer condition has no specified mathematical referent.

flagged.location: Statement, first paragraph: “the limiting magnetic field lies in its stabilizer algebra”
flagged.evidence: The Statement requires this boundary condition through the model’s asymptotic reduction, but the cited Definition does not define the limiting magnetic field, its domain, or its radial scaling. The condition remains part of the public Statement even though the proof does not use it.

flagged.location: Verification 4.2, sentence beginning “choose smooth lifts u_N,u_S”
flagged.evidence: Verification 4.2 asserts smooth lifts of ω↦−ωₐTₐ through u↦AdᵤT₃ on neighborhoods of the closed hemispheres, but supplies no formulas or existence argument. The model Definition requires such lifts without establishing them for this profile. Since the pulled-back Hopf bundle over each hemispheric neighborhood is trivial, this is a readily closable proof-step gap and is nonfatal.

The locator and Remarks state that the conversion to the item’s κ=−2Tr₂ convention gives g²=e²/2. The item has κ(Tₐ,Tᵦ)=δₐᵦ and E=(2g²)⁻¹∫κ(B²+(DΦ)²), while Tong’s §1.1 uses Tr(TₐTᵦ)=δₐᵦ/2 and §2.1.2, equation (2.16), has the corresponding traced quadratic term with coefficient 1/e². Since the item’s κ is twice that component trace, matching the energy gives g²=e², not e²/2. [Tong, §§1.1 and 2.1.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/0509216).
